data.reason: The user requests a comparison of GDP across three years (2019, 2020, 2024). To analyze economic growth or real changes over time, data must be adjusted for inflation using constant prices. Candidate 4 ('GDP, at constant 2020 prices - US Dollars') is the only series with a fixed base year (2020) that allows valid comparison across all requested years. Other candidates use 'current' prices or unspecified bases, which are unsuitable for multi-year trend analysis.
